name: select
title: Select
description: Opens a searchable list; pick one option with keyboard or click. Groups long option sets cleanly.

discovery.name: Select
discovery.description: Opens a searchable list; pick one option with keyboard or click. Groups long option sets cleanly.

gotchas.note: Controlled mode needs both value and onValueChange; open/onOpenChange for menu state.
Compose with SelectTrigger/SelectContent subcomponents — do not replace the trigger with a raw button.
Portal content may mismatch on first paint; prefer client-only mount for the open menu in Next.

agent.usage:
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem } from '@/components/atoms/Select';

<Select value={v} onValueChange={setV}>
  <SelectTrigger>Choose</SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="a">A</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
